headline: Renesas posts an architect role to define cross-domain verification for digital power products
fact: Renesas posted a Mixed Signal Verification Architect role to define scalable verification and validation for digital power products used in AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications. The mandate connects requirements, behavioral models, RTL, AMS simulation, emulation, bench validation, and silicon through measurable criteria, coverage expectations, correlation methods, automation, and reusable evidence.

sources.title: Mixed Signal Verification Architect
sources.summary: Official expired Renesas requisition dated June 16, 2026, whose mandate was to define cross-domain digital-power verification and correlation methods.
